opening.argument: The presentation promotes participation in dividend-style wallets and token purchases through claimed recurring benefits and profit from rising token prices. It presents PlusToken as an example, displaying a claim that its token rose more than 200 times from its initial price. The speaker then discusses timing before joining and describes an introduction mechanism, while the closing frame directs viewers to a LINE account for more information. Taken together, these are invitations to participate, not detached market commentary or criticism. The evidence supports that solicitation; it does not establish that viewers joined, earned profits, or suffered losses.

citations.quote: Firstly, you will receive monthly discounts! Secondly, you can purchase unlimited tokens they've prepared and earn profits with rising prices!
I want you to get some knowledge in this video before you join.
Third, let someone to take your introduction.
